thread:
Sam: FYI starting tenant_id type-swap during 03:00 UTC window. Plan: apply shadow table CTAS -> swap -> small EU canary -> staggered backfill per shard. Pin API to v2.8.1 for window.

deploy-bot: job=1789012345 accepted. workflow: ddl-ctas -> swap -> canary(3%) -> region-quiesce -> backfill-ratecap -> unpin. logs: https://deploy/logs/1789012345

Maya: how are we protecting from long locks? any chance of exclusive locks?

Sam: migration uses atomic table rename and new index creation off-line. No exclusive table locks expected. We'll monitor pg_locks and lock_waits.

Tim: adding a 20m manual review gate after swap. deploy-bot will pause and require `/deploybot continue 1789012345` to proceed. Abort command `/deploybot abort 1789012345`.

ops-team: backfill config: start 4r/s per worker, scale up to 15r/s if worker-cpu <65% and p95 <150ms. fallback: drop to 0.5r/s and run partial-index fallback.

Sam: abort triggers: lock_wait > 60s, backfill error-rate >1.5% sustained 5m, canary error-rate >1% for 10m. Add alert to #eng-releases.

Maya: please post a link to rollback steps in the thread for on-call.

Sam: rollback doc: https://confluence/rh/tenant-swap-rollback. Summary: stop backfill, revert API pin to v2.8.0, restore previous table by rename, run consistency-fix script.

deploy-bot: dry-run scheduled at 02:15 UTC against shadow shard-7. Will post result.

Sam: thanks. I'll own release notes entry and add the pin text and rollback bullets. Will update live here.

ops-team: dry-run successful on shard-7 (no locks, rename ok).

deploy-bot: swap applied at 1789012370, opening 20m manual gate.

Tim: canary metrics look nominal so far (errors 0.05%, p99 +2ms). Proceed when gate ack received.

Maya: acked, continuing to backfill EU. If anything hits triggers, we abort and follow rollback doc.

Sam: posting summary once fully unpinned. Good job team. :tada:
